arxiv-2005-14022.title: Detection and Classification of Internal Faults in Power Transformers using Tree based Classifiers
arxiv-2005-14022.creator: Samita Rani Pani, Pallav Kumar Bera, Vajendra Kumar
arxiv-2005-14022.description: Abstract This paper proposes a Decision Tree (DT) based detection and classification of internal faults in a power transformer. The faults are simulated in Power System Computer Aided Design (PSCAD)/ Electromagnetic Transients including DC (EMTDC) by varying the fault resistance, fault inception angle, and percentage of winding under fault.

arxiv-2202-03764.title: Spectral asymptotics for the fourth-order operator with periodic coefficients
arxiv-2202-03764.creator: Dmitry M. Polyakov
arxiv-2202-03764.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Dmitry M. Polyakov. We consider the self-adjoint fourth-order operator with real 1 1 -periodic coefficients on the unit interval. The spectrum of this operator is discrete. We determine the high energy asymptotics for its eigenvalues. Introduction and main result We consider the self-adjoint fourth-order operator H acting in the Hilbert space L^{2}(0,1) and given by Hy=y^{(4)}+(py^{\prime})^{\prime}+qy,\quad y^{\prime}(0)=y^{\prime\prime\prime}(0)+p(0)y^{\prime}(0)=y(1)=y^{\prime\prime}(1)=0, where p and q are real 1 -periodic coefficients, p , q\in L^{1}(\mathbb{T}) , \mathbb{T}=\mathbb{R}\setminus\mathbb{Z} .

arxiv-2206-00938.title: Exploiting Near-Data Processing to Accelerate Time Series Analysis
arxiv-2206-00938.creator: Ivan Fernandez § Ricardo Quislant § Christina Giannoula † \dagger Mohammed Alser ‡ \ddagger Juan Gómez-Luna ‡ \ddagger Eladio Gutiérrez § Oscar Plata § Onur Mutlu ‡ \ddagger § University of Malaga † \dagger National Technical University of Athens ‡ \ddagger ETH Zürich
arxiv-2206-00938.description: Abstract A time series is a chronologically ordered set of samples of a real-valued variable that can contain millions of observations. Time series analysis is used to analyze information in a wide variety of domains [ 128 ] : epidemiology, genomics, neuroscience, medicine, environmental sciences, economics, and more.

arxiv-2206-09744.title: Parameterisation of lane-change scenarios from real-world data
arxiv-2206-09744.creator: Dhanoop Karunakaran, Julie Stephany Berrio, Stewart Worrall, Eduardo Nebot
arxiv-2206-09744.description: Abstract Recent Autonomous Vehicles (AV) technology includes machine learning and probabilistic techniques that add significant complexity to the traditional verification and validation methods. The research community and industry have widely accepted scenario-based testing in the last few years. As it is focused directly on the relevant crucial road situations, it can reduce the effort required in testing.

arxiv-2305-01614.title: On the Collaborative Object Transportation Using Leader Follower Approach
arxiv-2305-01614.creator: Sumanta Ghosh, Subhajit Nath, Sarvesh Sortee, Lokesh Kumar, Titas Bera
arxiv-2305-01614.description: Abstract In this paper we address the multi-agent collaborative object transportation problem in a partially known environment with obstacles under a specified goal condition. We propose a leader follower approach for two mobile manipulators collaboratively transporting an object along specified desired trajectories.

arxiv-2305-15439.title: Tests of general relativity in the nonlinear regime: a parametrized plunge-merger-ringdown waveform model
arxiv-2305-15439.creator: E. Maggio
arxiv-2305-15439.description: Abstract Gravitational waves (GWs) provide a unique opportunity to test gravity in the dynamical and nonlinear regime. We present a parametrized test of general relativity (GR) that introduces generic deviations to the plunge, merger and ringdown stages of binary–black-hole coalescences. The novel feature of the model is that it can capture signatures of beyond-GR physics in the plunge-merger phase.

arxiv-2309-00486.title: A new calculus for intuitionistic Strong Löb logic: strong termination and cut-elimination, formalised
arxiv-2309-00486.creator: Ian Shillito, Iris van der Giessen, Rajeev Goré, Rosalie Iemhoff
arxiv-2309-00486.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Ian Shillito, Iris van der Giessen, Rajeev Goré, Rosalie Iemhoff. We provide a new sequent calculus that enjoys syntactic cut-elimination and strongly terminating backward proof search for the intuitionistic Strong Löb logic 𝗂𝖲𝖫 \mathsf{iSL} , an intuitionistic modal logic with a provability interpretation. A novel measure on sequents is used to prove both the termination of the naive backward proof search strategy, and the admissibility of cut in a syntactic and direct way, leading to a straightforward cut-elimination procedure.

arxiv-2404-01869.title: Beyond Accuracy: Evaluating the Reasoning Behavior of Large Language Models - A Survey
arxiv-2404-01869.creator: Philipp Mondorf & Barbara Plank
arxiv-2404-01869.description: Abstract Large language models (LLMs) have recently shown impressive performance on tasks involving reasoning, leading to a lively debate on whether these models possess reasoning capabilities similar to humans. However, despite these successes, the depth of LLMs’ reasoning abilities remains uncertain.

arxiv-2407-17829.title: Why Divisive Normalization works in image segmentation?
arxiv-2407-17829.creator: Pablo Hernández-Cámara, Jorge Vila-Tomás, Paula Dauden-Oliver, Nuria Alabau-Bosque, Valero Laparra, Jesús Malo
arxiv-2407-17829.description: Abstract Autonomous driving is a challenging scenario for image segmentation due to the presence of uncontrolled environmental conditions and the eventually catastrophic consequences of failures. Previous work suggested that a biologically motivated computation, the so-called Divisive Normalization, could be useful to deal with image variability, but its effects have not been systematically studied over different data sources and environmental factors.

arxiv-2505-12289.title: BOLT: Block-Orthonormal Lanczos for Trace estimation of matrix functions
arxiv-2505-12289.creator: Kingsley Yeon, Promit Ghosal, Mihai Anitescu
arxiv-2505-12289.description: Abstract Efficient matrix trace estimation is essential for scalable computation of log-determinants, matrix norms, and distributional divergences. In many large-scale applications, the matrices involved are too large to store or access in full, making even a single matrix–vector (mat–vec) product infeasible.

arxiv-2509-06709.title: Dynamics of an autocatalytic reaction front: effects of imposed turbulence and buoyancy-driven flows
arxiv-2509-06709.creator: Nihal Tawdi, Christophe Almarcha, Michael Le Bars
arxiv-2509-06709.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Nihal Tawdi, Christophe Almarcha, Michael Le Bars. Thin flame dynamics in a turbulent flow remains debated (e.g. [ 1 , 2 , 3 , 4 , 5 , 6 , 7 ] ), with various parameterizations proposed for the typical flame propagation velocity. According to the classical Damköhler’s model based on Huygens’ principle, a flame front should advance at a constant velocity normal to the interface between reactants and products, with a turbulent acceleration induced by the wrinkling and surface increase of the interface.

arxiv-2601-17209.title: Polynomial Chaos-based Input Shaper Design under Time-Varying Uncertainty
arxiv-2601-17209.creator: Johannes Güttler, Karan Baker, Premjit Saha, James Warner, Adrian Stein
arxiv-2601-17209.description: Abstract The work presented here investigates the application of polynomial chaos expansion toward input shaper design in order to maintain robustness in dynamical systems subject to uncertainty. Furthermore, this work intends to specifically address time-varying uncertainty by employing intrusive polynomial chaos expansion.

uslaw-usc-t10-s9018.title: 10 U.S.C. § 9018 — Administrative Assistant
uslaw-usc-t10-s9018.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t10-s9018.description: United States Code, Title 10 (Armed Forces); Part I (Organization); Chapter 903 (Department Of The Air Force). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. The Secretary of the Air Force may appoint an Administrative Assistant in the Office of the Secretary of the Air Force. The Administrative Assistant shall perform such duties as the Secretary may prescribe.
